entryGate: Decision D28 (owner instruction, 1 October 2026): Phase 1 complete as defined in document 13 section 1 and certified (N30); nothing in Phase 2 starts earlier, including the M0 decisions. Every Phase 2 slice depends on SP01 and SP01 on N30. The desktop-parity golden, write-set and journey suites stay blocking for every Phase 2 change.

statusMeaning.in-progress: Started on a branch; evidence paths required.
statusMeaning.implemented-unverified: Merged with evidence; milestone exit not yet accepted.

milestones.title: Phase 2 decisions
milestones.exit: Edition-to-plan matrix, pricing, legal entity and GST, identity, provider, residency, SLO/RPO/RTO and offline decisions signed by the owner.

milestones.title: Supported, contract-first foundation
milestones.exit: Platform upgrades pass the parity suites; every route lives in a module plugin with a schema; OpenAPI and the contract package are generated in CI.

milestones.title: Tenant and identity control plane
milestones.exit: Platform realm and roles, trusted tenant resolution, tenant lifecycle, entitlements and support grants exist; the multi-tenant isolation suite is green.

milestones.title: Cloud operations and onboarding
milestones.exit: Jobs, object storage, tenant secrets, managed backups with a verified per-tenant restore, the company wizard and the assisted migration service work end to end.

milestones.title: Commercial console
milestones.exit: Plans, metering, payments, dunning and GST subscription invoices reconcile; the super-admin console passes its role-based journeys.

milestones.title: Security and operability
milestones.exit: DPDP workflows and contracts, India residency, telemetry with SLOs and alerts, threat model, penetration test and incident runbooks accepted.

milestones.title: Assisted pilot
milestones.exit: Three to five representative tenants run two billing cycles with no open severity 1 or 2 defect; reconciliation, SLO and restore drills pass; tenants sign off.

milestones.title: General availability and measured scale
milestones.exit: Support, legal and commercial handover done; capacity stages are entered only when their measured triggers fire.

slices.title: Phase 2 decisions and the edition-to-plan matrix
steps: Build the menu-by-menu entitlement matrix from the desktop edition codes (MDI_FORM.cs edition branches) and the menu catalog phases
Record pricing, trial, add-on, grace and overage mechanics, legal entity, GST registration and invoice series
Record identity (subdomain, login identifier, MFA, SSO scope), residency, provider, SLO/RPO/RTO and offline decisions as ADR-0005 onward
tests: Every catalog menu maps to exactly one plan or add-on
slices.doneWhen: Every M0 decision is signed and the matrix covers all 198 menus.

slices.title: Platform upgrade: Next.js 16 and current React, PostgreSQL 18 (Prisma 7 lands in Phase 1 under N86, D26)
steps: Upgrade one component per pull request: Next.js and React (unless N86 already moved to Next.js 16), Prisma 7 only if N86 recorded a risk acceptance instead, then PostgreSQL 18 through a logical replica rehearsal
Run the full engineering gates, the zero-mock browser suite and the desktop differential after each step
Record rollback for each step
tests: Unchanged write sets and report datasets before and after each upgrade
slices.doneWhen: Next.js, React, Prisma and PostgreSQL are on supported versions with green parity suites.

slices.title: Contract-first API: finish route-plugin extraction, OpenAPI and a shared contract package
steps: Move the remaining route families out of routes/txn.ts into module plugins with JSON Schemas
Generate OpenAPI from the schemas and TypeScript client types into packages/types
Fail CI on an undocumented route or an incompatible API change; publish /v1 versioning rules
tests: Route-universe test exact; schema coverage 100% of mutation routes; OpenAPI diff check
slices.doneWhen: routes/txn.ts is gone or a thin index, every route has a schema and the API document is generated.

slices.title: Trusted tenant resolution and tenant catalog
steps: Resolve tenant-code.product-domain (or tenant code at login for custom domains) to an immutable tenant ID before credentials are checked
Strip any public x-tenant-id header; accept internal tenant context only from an authenticated edge
Reject any request, job or socket whose host tenant differs from the token tenant
tests: Two-tenant suite across every route, report, export, job, cache key and object path; spoofed-header and wrong-host negatives
slices.doneWhen: One deployment serves many tenants with no header trust and the isolation suite is green.

slices.title: Platform identity realm, roles and MFA
steps: Separate platform user store, issuer, audience, signing keys and cookies on a separate host name
Roles owner, support, billing and read-only security; mandatory phishing-resistant MFA
Tenant users gain invitations, recovery and admin MFA; company/location rights stay as today
tests: Platform tokens rejected on tenant routes and the reverse; role matrix tests
slices.doneWhen: No platform identity can act as a tenant user and every platform action is attributable.

slices.title: Tenant lifecycle and directory
steps: State machine draft, trialing, active, past_due, suspended, export_only, deletion_pending, deleted
Suspension refuses business mutations but allows read, export and billing
Deletion requires a final export, two-person approval, object deletion and backup expiry
tests: Every transition with its allowed and refused actions
slices.doneWhen: The lifecycle is enforced server-side and audited.

slices.title: Entitlements, plan limits and feature flags
steps: Versioned entitlements per plan and add-on, evaluated server-side on every route through the route policy
Limits for companies, locations, users and storage with warnings at 80, 90 and 100 percent; limits never block saving financial records already in progress
Feature flags for rollout and SaaS workflow changes, separate from entitlements, defaulting to desktop behaviour (D25)
tests: Boundary tests per limit; flag on and off journeys show identical accounting results
slices.doneWhen: Menus and routes follow the tenant's plan and flags, with audited overrides.

slices.title: Consented support access
steps: Tenant admin grants a ticket-bound, time-boxed, read-only-by-default session
Visible banner, step-up MFA, full audit and tenant notification
Mutation only with fresh consent or two-person break-glass approval
tests: Expired, revoked and out-of-scope grants are refused
slices.doneWhen: Support works without shared passwords and every access is visible to the tenant.

slices.title: Durable jobs: transactional outbox, queue and workers
steps: Outbox rows written in the business transaction; a relay publishes to a managed queue
Workers for PDFs, reports, exports, messaging, provider calls, migration and backups, with per-tenant concurrency limits
Retries, dead letters and a job dashboard
tests: Worker killed after commit, duplicate delivery and queue outage: no lost or doubled effect
slices.doneWhen: No long-running or external work runs inside an HTTP request.

slices.title: Object storage for images, documents and exports
steps: Move ENTITY_IMAGE bytes and generated PDFs/exports to tenant-prefixed object storage; keep metadata, hash and version in PostgreSQL
Signed, expiring URLs checked against tenant and rights
Backfill existing images with checksums
tests: Cross-tenant URL refusal; checksum equality after backfill
slices.doneWhen: The database holds no image or document bytes.

slices.title: Per-tenant integration secrets and provider settings
steps: GSP, WhatsApp and SMS credentials stored as secrets-manager references per tenant and GSTIN
Staged validation, rotation and revocation from the tenant console
Secrets never returned by APIs or included in exports
tests: Two tenants with different providers send through their own credentials
slices.doneWhen: No provider credential is a process-wide environment variable.

slices.title: Managed backup, point-in-time recovery and per-tenant restore
steps: Managed PostgreSQL with PITR and encrypted off-site copies in India
Per-tenant restore into an isolated database, checksum and reconciliation, then approved promotion
Quarterly restore drills with measured RPO and RTO
tests: Restore of one tenant leaves every other tenant unchanged
slices.doneWhen: A single tenant can be restored to a point in time without affecting others, and drills meet the agreed RPO/RTO.

slices.title: Onboarding: company wizard, sample data and guided setup
steps: Wizard for legal identity, GST, financial year, locations, books, chart template, taxes, rates, devices, users and integrations, previewed before one atomic creation using the N58 provisioning
Optional, clearly marked sample data removable before the first real posting
Checklist of first sale, purchase, receipt, report and backup
tests: A wizard-created company equals a desktop-provisioned company under the N58 comparison
slices.doneWhen: A new customer reaches a first valid invoice without support.

slices.title: Desktop migration as a service
steps: Encrypted upload, quarantine and staged restore of the customer's SQL Server backups
Idempotent, checkpointed ETL using the N78 ownership manifest, with row, ledger and report reconciliation
Two rehearsals, freeze and delta, cutover and rollback, signed acceptance
tests: Reconciliation reports for two representative customers
slices.doneWhen: An existing desktop customer moves with a signed reconciliation and a tested rollback.

slices.title: Subscriptions, payments and GST subscription invoices
steps: Internal subscription state is authoritative; gateway webhooks are signed, idempotent inputs
Renewal, retries, dunning, grace and manual payment
Immutable GST invoices and credit notes with SAC, place of supply and a financial-year series, per the owner's tax decision
tests: Duplicate, out-of-order and lost webhooks; invoice sequence and tax arithmetic
slices.doneWhen: Two billing cycles reconcile between gateway, subscriptions and invoices.

slices.title: Usage metering and limit enforcement
steps: Append-only meter events (companies, locations, active users, storage bytes, documents, e-invoices, messages) with daily roll-ups
Limit evaluation from roll-ups with audited adjustments
Usage shown to tenants and to the billing console
tests: Roll-ups are reproducible from raw events
slices.doneWhen: Every billable unit is metered and explainable.

slices.title: Super-admin console
steps: Tenant directory with status, plan, usage, onboarding and health
Plans, subscriptions, invoices and refunds for the billing role
Announcements, job and queue dashboard, security events, data requests and migration runs
tests: Role-based end-to-end journeys for owner, support and billing; tenant admins cannot reach platform routes
slices.doneWhen: The platform team can operate tenants without database access.

slices.title: Observability, SLOs and on-call
steps: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs for API, workers, database and browser with correlation IDs; tenant ID as a restricted attribute
SLOs for availability, financial-write errors, queue latency and backup freshness with error-budget alerts
On-call rota, runbooks, status page and post-incident reviews
tests: Synthetic failure raises the right alert within its budget
slices.doneWhen: Every SLO has a dashboard, an alert and a runbook.

slices.title: DPDP compliance and data-principal requests
steps: Notices, consent where required and equally easy withdrawal, before the dates that apply (14 November 2026 and 14 May 2027)
Access, correction, erasure and grievance requests routed to the right tenant, with statutory retention holds for accounting records
Breach workflow, processor contracts, retention schedule, DPA and subprocessor list
tests: Request lifecycle tests including retention conflicts
slices.doneWhen: Legal review signs the workflows and documents.

slices.title: Security assurance and platform audit
steps: Durable, transactional audit for platform, billing, support and deletion actions with tamper-evident export
Threat model; SAST, dependency, SBOM, container and infrastructure-as-code scanning in CI
Independent penetration test before the pilot and yearly
tests: Planted vulnerable dependency and secret are blocked
slices.doneWhen: No open high finding from the penetration test.

slices.title: SaaS workflow refinements behind tenant flags
steps: Managed backups and approved restore replace drive backup and restore; cloud import/export jobs replace file transfer
Device and session management replaces the HDD registry; per-user favourites replace global tiles
Approval inbox for edit/delete requests; guarded year-end and renumber jobs with preview, backup and two-person approval
tests: Each flag on and off produces identical ledger, stock and report results
slices.doneWhen: Every desktop-only utility has a safe hosted equivalent and migrated tenants keep desktop behaviour by default.

slices.title: Responsive task views and notifications
steps: Responsive views for approvals, lookups, stock checks and dashboards; dense desktop grids stay for data entry
Notification centre with optional email, push and WhatsApp, preferences and deep links
Supported browser and device matrix with accessibility checks
tests: Visual and accessibility checks on the supported matrix
slices.doneWhen: Mobile task views pass the matrix without changing desktop-grid entry.

slices.title: Assisted pilot and general availability
steps: Three to five representative tenants, migrated or new
Two billing cycles, restore drill and SLO review
GA gate with support, legal and commercial handover
tests: Pilot acceptance checklist signed by each tenant
slices.doneWhen: M6 and M7 exits are signed.

slices.title: Capacity stages on measured triggers
steps: Stage triggers written as SLO and capacity thresholds (connections, queue lag, report latency, storage)
In order, only when triggered: API replicas and connection pooling; read replicas for stale-tolerant reports; time partitioning of audit, job and meter tables; tenant cells with a tenant catalog
Load tests at twice the forecast peak with a noisy-neighbour tenant before each stage
tests: Load profile per stage; cell move rehearsal
slices.doneWhen: Each stage is entered by a recorded trigger and leaves SLOs green.
